summary: Phase A Testing Complete: OSCAL Support & CI/CD Pipeline Integration. All 24 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend UI tests passed. Features verified: OSCAL import (catalog, component-definition), OSCAL export (catalog, assessment-results), Pipeline API keys (create, list, revoke), Pipeline webhook (X-Pipeline-Key auth), Pipeline gate evaluation (pass/fail/warn), Pipeline runs (list, detail, delete), Pipeline stats, Frontend DevSecOps Pipeline dashboard with stats and runs list, API Keys view with integration guide, OSCAL option in ingestion upload.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase A of IronVision GRC upgrade complete. Key features: (1) OSCAL Support - POST /api/oscal/import parses OSCAL catalog (controls from groups), component-definition (control implementations), assessment-results (findings). GET /api/oscal/export/catalog/{framework_id} exports framework as OSCAL catalog JSON. GET /api/oscal/export/assessment/{framework_id} exports compliance results as OSCAL assessment-results JSON. OSCAL imports stored in ingested_checklists collection with source_type 'oscal-catalog' or 'oscal-component-definition'. (2) CI/CD Pipeline Integration - POST /api/pipeline/api-keys creates API key (returns raw key once, stores hash). GET /api/pipeline/api-keys lists keys (excludes hash). DELETE /api/pipeline/api-keys/{key_id} revokes key. POST /api/pipeline/webhook receives scan findings (X-Pipeline-Key auth), calculates risk score, stores run and findings. POST /api/pipeline/gate evaluates compliance gate (pass/fail/warn based on policy thresholds). GET /api/pipeline/runs lists runs. GET /api/pipeline/runs/{run_id} returns run with findings. DELETE /api/pipeline/runs/{run_id} deletes run and findings. GET /api/pipeline/stats returns aggregate statistics. (3) Frontend - DevSecOps Pipeline button on Frameworks page opens pipeline dashboard with stats (total runs, findings, pass rate, avg risk score, pass/warn/fail counts) and runs list. API Keys view shows create form, integration guide with curl examples, and existing keys. OSCAL option added to ingestion upload source types. Sample OSCAL files at /app/backend/sample_checklists/.

notes.oscal_support: OSCAL v1.2.1 compatible. Supports catalog, component-definition, and assessment-results document types. Imports stored in ingested_checklists collection for unified control graph.
notes.pipeline_auth: Webhook and gate endpoints use X-Pipeline-Key header (not JWT). All other pipeline endpoints (runs, stats, api-keys) use JWT auth.
notes.risk_scoring: Risk score calculated as: critical*10 + high*5 + medium*2 + low*1 + info*0
notes.gate_policies: Three policies available: strict (0 critical, 0 high, 5 medium, 10 risk), default (0 critical, 3 high, 10 medium, 30 risk), permissive (1 critical, 10 high, 50 medium, 100 risk)
